name: PaymentCard
description: A credit card number input that auto-formats with spaces and detects the card type (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover) from the first digits. Displays a card type indicator label at the start of the input.

notes: The input has aria-label='Credit card number' for screen readers.
The card type indicator is aria-hidden so it does not pollute the accessible name.
autocomplete='cc-number' is set for browser autofill support.
Focus indicator uses a 2px solid outline with var(--color-border-focus) and a 2px offset.

onChange.description: Called when the card number changes. Receives digits only.

size.description: Controls the input height, padding, and font size.

error.description: Shows an error (invalid) border style using color-border-danger.

positive.description: Shows a positive (success/valid) border style using color-border-success.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the outer wrapper div.

do: Use with a FormLabel to provide an accessible name.
Use the onChange callback to receive digits-only values.
The component handles formatting — do not pre-format the value.
dont: Do not use inline styles to adjust appearance — add a token and use var(--token-name) in the CSS.
Do not pass a pre-formatted value with spaces — pass digits only.
